name: Cybersima Threat API
install: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3.12-venv && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python -c "from app import app, db; ctx = app.app_context(); ctx.push(); db.create_all(); ctx.pop()"
